about: What each game brings, and how it is read. Nothing from either game is copied into the other game's folder or into the upload.

columns.read: how it is read at runtime

rows.what: every ROUNDS card (base game + installed card mods): name, description, rarity, colour theme, stat lines
the real ROUNDS card faces with their animated art
rows.read: ROUNDS instantiates the card and renders it with its own camera to a texture
Gun / CharacterStatModifiers / Block components on the card prefab, folded with ROUNDS's own ApplyStats rules

rows.what: each player's ROUNDS face (eyes, mouth, details): the one made in the launcher's face editor, else the player's own saved ROUNDS face; built and rendered by ROUNDS in its own colours; worn in levels, in card picks and on the world map
rows.read: CharacterCreatorHandler faces (the launcher's faces.txt put into its selectedPlayerFaces by Faces.ApplyChoice) + CharacterCreatorItemLoader sprites

rows.what: every ROUNDS face part (eyes, mouths, details), the player's eight saved faces and the bare ROUNDS body, as pictures for the launcher's face editor
rows.read: a hidden ROUNDS run (--roundhead-faces, Faces.DrawSheet) poses ROUNDS's own player as a puppet and renders them into %LOCALAPPDATA%/CupRounds/faces on the player's PC; nothing is shipped or uploaded
player prefab holdable gun SpriteRenderer and bullet prefab

rows.what: ROUNDS card mods the player chooses
rows.read: launcher downloads them from thunderstore.io into the mashup's own ROUNDS profile

rows.what: the whole campaign: map, bosses, run-and-gun levels, music, story, shop, saves
rows.read: Cuphead itself is the host; the plugin only patches the player

rows.what: the real ROUNDS player character with its own animation: particle skin in team colour, saved face, IK legs that step, IK arms (one holding the swaying gun, one carrying the block orb), jump and land smoke, block burst, hit blink
rows.read: ROUNDS instantiates its own player prefab as a puppet, drives it from the blob's pose and renders it with its own camera
